marks.name: The axis is speed against capability, not money
marks.why: Agora charges a flat $0.10 per agent-minute and its docs say the price is the same with your own key, so Lowest Cost was measuring a number that never moves.

marks.name: Price is a state until the money is real
marks.why: It reads the same at every stop on purpose. It becomes a figure only when a slot leaves the Agora Managed Key, which is the one place a stack choice changes the bill.

name: after8-credentials
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await wait(900);const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Or configure models manually'));if(b&&b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='false')b.click();await wait(900);document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Configure STT vendor and credential"]')?.click();await wait(1100);document.querySelector('#wz-cred-asr-field')?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});await wait(400);})()

marks.name: A checkbox, not another switch
marks.why: The sheet already carries one switch per backup. A column of toggles that mean different things reads as noise, so the credential choice is a checkbox and the Agora Managed Key line dropped its explainer.

marks.name: Custom is about the model, and says so
marks.why: It was labelled just Custom, and it was missing from backups entirely. Both now take a model id by hand.

name: after8-create-credential
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await wait(900);const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Or configure models manually'));if(b&&b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='false')b.click();await wait(900);document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Configure STT vendor and credential"]')?.click();await wait(1100);document.querySelector('#wz-cred-asr')?.click();await wait(700);const t=document.querySelector('#wz-cred-asr-pick');t&&t.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,button:0,pointerType:'mouse',pointerId:1}));await wait(600);const opt=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')].find(o=>o.textContent.includes('Create credential'));if(opt){opt.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,pointerType:'mouse',pointerId:1}));opt.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,button:0,pointerType:'mouse',pointerId:1}));}await wait(900);})()

marks.name: Keys are made without leaving the builder
marks.why: Create credential used to navigate to another page, which throws away the draft's React state. It is a dialog now. Only the last four characters are kept, which is all the picker ever shows.

marks.name: One panel with a contents page
marks.why: There were four hiding places and no way to know which held what. Every group is named here with what it holds, and a section's button lands you on its group rather than opening a different sheet.

marks.name: Conversation history was loose in the model expander
marks.why: It is an advanced setting, so it lives with the others. Custom config JSON came with it.

name: after8-opening-fields
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await wait(1800);for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=radio]')].find(r=>r.textContent.trim()==='Agent'&&r.getBoundingClientRect().width>0);if(a&&a.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='true')break;if(a)a.click();await wait(350);}await wait(700);for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const sw=document.getElementById('wz-opening-disclose');if(sw&&sw.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='true')break;if(sw)sw.click();await wait(350);}await wait(800);document.getElementById('wz-opening-disclosure')?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});await wait(600);})()

marks.name: The disclosure is a field, and it cites the law
marks.why: It was a line of text with an Edit link. It is a sentence the caller hears, so it is edited like one, and the rule for the pinned region sits under it with a link to the primary source.

marks.name: Callers hear stopped pretending to be a field
marks.why: A read-only textarea invites typing. It is the composed line, shown as a line, and the sentence explaining that it was read-only is gone.

name: after8-go-live
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await wait(1000);for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=radio][value="batch"]')].find(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0);if(r&&r.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='true')break;if(r)r.click();await wait(400);}await wait(1400);const go=[...document.querySelectorAll('nav button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Go live'));go&&go.click();await wait(1600);const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('dt')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Deployed to');h&&h.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});await wait(600);})()

marks.name: The summary says how many it will call
marks.why: It listed the models and the voice but never the size of the batch. The card around it is gone too: nothing else in this section has one.

marks.name: Go live asks one thing
marks.why: The campaign-runs card, its roll-up, its status filter and its second caller-ID picker are gone. The contact list and the number were chosen in Deployment; asking again read as a trap.
